summary: Two conversion policy kinds: source_discrepancy (a legacy trial balance that is itself out of balance by an exact amount in one account; that account opens at the source balance-sheet figure so every conversion entry balances, with the source amounts kept on record) and fund_allocation (an account's opening split by the source's fund columns, proposed and approved like every other conversion object). Widens conversion_policies_policy_kind_check and replaces conversion_policies_guard with the same rules plus the two kinds (keyed by account, exact cents / parts, source evidence required). No existing row changes.

preflight.name: conversion_policies exists (535 applied)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'conversion_policies'

preflight.name: no policy uses the new kinds yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM conversion_policies WHERE policy_kind IN ('source_discrepancy','fund_allocation')

expected_changes: conversion_policies_policy_kind_check also allows source_discrepancy and fund_allocation.

conversion_policies_guard keys both new kinds by account and refuses a source discrepancy without exact non-zero cents, basis balance_sheet and evidence, or a fund allocation without parts, basis source_fund_columns and evidence. Every existing rule is unchanged.
No row changes in any table.

verify.name: the policy kind check allows source_discrepancy and fund_allocation
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'conversion_policies_policy_kind_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%source_discrepancy%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%fund_allocation%'

verify.name: the policy guard knows both kinds
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'conversion_policies_guard' AND prosrc LIKE '%source_discrepancy%' AND prosrc LIKE '%fund_allocation%'
